A1.justification: Both PDFs describe K-RagRec. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables and appendices support comparison despite substantial reformatting and relocation of material.

before.justification: v1 reports original recommendation experiments, component ablations, zero-shot transfer, efficiency measurements and parameter studies, including appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds hallucination and cold-start evaluations in Appendices A.8–A.9.

M1.justification: The indexing GNN, popularity threshold, retrieval, re-ranking, graph encoder, projector and training objective remain unchanged. Adaptive Retrieval Policy is renamed Popularity Selective Retrieval Policy; the additional explanation does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: v2 adds a fictional-candidate scenario on MovieLens-1M and a MovieLens-derived evaluation restricted to cold-start targets. MovieLens-1M, MovieLens-20M, Amazon Book and Freebase remain the underlying coverage.

E2.justification: Matched experiments retain their comparator membership. The new cold-start study reuses PT w/ KG-Text, GraphToken w/ RAG and G-retriever; the hallucination study uses direct inference, already evaluated as w/o RAG in v1's efficiency study.

E3.justification: Appendices A.8–A.9 introduce fictional-candidate insertion with hallucination-rate measurement and evaluation restricted to cold-start targets. Existing leave-one-out procedures, candidate counts, metrics, backbones and training settings are unchanged. The new candidate counts and cold-start identification criteria are unspecified.

E4.justification: v2 adds targeted tests of fictional-movie recommendations and performance on cold-start targets, providing substantive new diagnostic evidence for central motivations. The original component ablations, zero-shot transfer, encoder comparisons and sensitivity studies are retained, with several moved into the appendix.

E5.justification: Both Appendix A.1 sections specify three runs with different random seeds and averaged results. v2 adds no confidence intervals, significance tests, variability estimates or revised repetition policy.

E6.justification: New Table 7 reports direct-inference/K-RagRec hallucination rates of 39.1%/2.7% for LLama-2 and 4.7%/0.9% for QWEN2. New Table 8 reports cold-start accuracy of 0.406 for K-RagRec versus 0.258 for GraphToken w/ RAG. These add important result categories; matched pre-existing tables and plotted results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and methodological equations are retained. The generic GNN equation moves from Section 3.1 to Appendix A.2 and is renumbered. No new formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The abstract and four principal contributions retain their scientific scope: structured KG retrieval, multiscale indexing, popularity-based retrieval efficiency and graph encoding for recommendations. The new experiments support existing claims without redefining the central contribution.

C2.justification: v2 explains that larger retrieval thresholds can displace cold-start knowledge when the re-ranking budget is fixed. Section 6 newly identifies the limitations of popularity-based selection and proposes policies responsive to changing user interests, while retaining the model-size and Freebase limitations.

D1.justification: Hardware, software, hyperparameters, acceleration settings, prompt examples and dataset access information are retained, including v1 Table 7 as v2 Table 4. The new diagnostic studies add no implementation settings, code access or detailed dataset-construction instructions.

R1.justification: New Appendix A.4 explicitly contrasts per-layer indexing with G-Retriever/GNN-RAG and popularity-based selection with existing selective-retrieval approaches. v2 adds related citations and popularity-bias sources while removing several peripheral citations; the broad research positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Substantial material moves into an expanded appendix: GNN preliminaries, LLM recommendation related work, ablation definitions, generalization and encoder/layer studies. The retrieval policy is consistently renamed, limitations are reorganized, and author information and acknowledgements are expanded.

P2.justification: v2 switches from single-column to two-column layout, resizing and relocating numerous displays. Several tables move into the appendix, Figures 4–6 are collected near its end, figure labels reflect the policy rename, and two new diagnostic tables are added.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens support for the unchanged framework through targeted hallucination and cold-start evidence, clearer comparisons with prior methods, and an explicit limitation of popularity-based retrieval. The gain is limited because the added tests omit fictional-candidate counts and cold-start identification criteria, leaving their reproducibility and evidential scope incompletely documented.
